entity: The 2025 Texas state water-pollution judgment against the recycling operation at Altair (Skull Creek / Inland Recycling / Polston)
what_we_add: The comparison: biggest state water penalty on file after BP's $3.35B lines. No source ranks it.
why: Texas Tribune and the AG report the $60M judgment against Polston's Inland companies over Skull Creek at Altair; the county paper puts civil penalties at $46.5M. Same case, same direction, both within 25% of our $57.0M. The all-time-second ranking is ours alone.
